evidence.quote: if (from.id.value === to.id.value) throw new LedgerError('cannot transfer to the same account');
if (from.currency !== to.currency) throw new LedgerError(`currency mismatch: ${from.currency} vs ${to.currency}`);

answer.rationale: The same-account and currency-mismatch checks are business invariants of a transfer. They are enforced in the application service, reading Account state, rather than in Account or a value object. Account.deposit and withdraw never check currency, so the aggregate does not own the rule. These are not input parsing or cross-aggregate uniqueness checks.
